sense.text:
“For the gifts and calling of God are without repentance.” The gift is the Holy Spirit. And the calling of God is without repentance: when God calls you and you first hear this truth and start learning it, a lot of you have not fully repented as yet. When you first come up in here, many brothers and sisters are dealing with many different things.

But this is the right place to learn and to fix those things. That is what you are here for: to fix these things.

precepts.why:
When you learn this gospel and come amongst us, you have to fix the things you have been dealing with: the lust, the adultery, all of it. In the beginning, when God calls you, you are in the midst of all type of sin, but you have to learn to kill these things and destroy the demons you are fighting.

“Know ye not that the unrighteous shall not inherit the kingdom of God?” If you are unrighteous, you are not going to inherit the kingdom of God. “Be not deceived”: don’t deceive yourself. Don’t think you can be in the midst of adultery, be a gossiper, carry hatred, and be amongst us deceiving yourself.

“Neither fornicators”: fornication falls under any sex that breaks the law of thou shalt not commit adultery, any relationship outside of marriage. All the sins in Leviticus 18 fall under fornication. Having sex with a woman outside the umbrella of marriage is fornication; having sex with prostitutes is fornication. “Nor idolaters, nor adulterers, nor effeminate, nor abusers of themselves with mankind, nor thieves, nor covetous, nor drunkards, nor revilers, nor extortioners, shall inherit the kingdom of God.”

“And such were some of you.” Some of the brothers and sisters in the church of Corinth were involved in the things just read. They heard the high calling of God, and they repented of it. It is the same for brothers and sisters today. A lot of you were the things read there, but when you get that high calling of God and come amongst us, you have to repent and change. Stop dealing with the prostitutes, stop being an adulterer, stop lying, stop stealing.

Paul says, “For I fear, lest, when I come, I shall not find you such as I would”, “lest there be debates, envyings, wraths, strifes, backbitings, whisperings, swellings, tumults”, and that he “shall bewail many which have sinned already, and have not repented.”

There were brothers and sisters who heard the high calling of God and got rid of their old sins, but they went back to them. It is the same today. A lot of you heard the high calling of God, came amongst us, heard it with joy and said, let me get myself together, and then fell right back into the sins you repented of. Why are brothers and sisters falling backwards? Because some of you are idle, and that is how you allow Satan to overcome you.

They had “not repented of the uncleanness and fornication and lasciviousness which they have committed.” Those are sexual sins. Most of the sins people deal with when they come to the truth are sexual; that sexual lust is one of the biggest a brother or sister deals with. Many in the church of Corinth went backwards and sinned, and the same thing is happening in IUIC with a lot of you getting caught up in lasciviousness, uncleanness and fornication.

“But let none of you suffer as a murderer, or as a thief, or as an evildoer, or as a busybody in other men’s matters.” Coming to this truth, none of us should suffer as a murderer. You should not have that hatred spirit on you. If you were in a gang and come amongst us, you have to get away from that gang; you should not still be on that gangster stuff. None of us should suffer as an evildoer, out there committing all type of crimes. All the old things you used to do, you have to cut them out. And the busybody is always in somebody’s business, getting involved in things that do not concern him, and then somebody punches him in his face or he gets caught up in some drama.

“Yet if any man suffer as a Christian, let him not be ashamed; but let him glorify God on this behalf.” The word Christian means anointed. It is not talking about the white Christians singing Jesus loves the little children. If you suffer being an Israelite called in this truth, one of Christ’s anointed ones, don’t be ashamed of that kind of suffering, but glorify God for it, because the Lord chose you.

“For the time is come that judgment must begin at the house of God.” Judgment always starts at the house of God; always remember that. “And if it first begin at us, what shall the end be of them that obey not the gospel of God? And if the righteous scarcely be saved, where shall the ungodly and the sinner appear?”

“Wherefore let them that suffer according to the will of God commit the keeping of their souls to him in well doing.” You must do well; you must do good. When you come through these doors you have to change. Change does not happen overnight; change takes time. But the leaders are here to help. If you are dealing with certain things, come to the leaders, and you brothers that lead congregations, when people come to you with something, help them. Every last one of you has demons you are fighting. If you were perfect, Christ would not have had to come and die for you. But some of you are being choked out by that demon; some of you this week were secretly fornicating. You came, and you never really stopped.

“Examine yourselves, whether ye be in the faith; prove your own selves.” Every last one of us has to examine himself. Nobody can examine you; you examine yourself. “Know ye not your own selves”: you know the evil you are fighting inside, the thoughts you have, the evil you do secretly when you say no one sees you. So do self-reflection. Look in the mirror and ask yourself, am I real? You alone know the things you are fighting, so you have to go to yourself and say, I’m going to stop doing this.

“How that Jesus Christ is in you, except ye be reprobates?” If you can’t examine yourself, you are reprobate. Some brothers and sisters say they are in the faith, but they are not; they are amongst us and in the midst of all type of evil secretly, and they keep allowing Satan to overcome them, keep giving in to lasciviousness and fornication.

“But I trust that ye shall know that we are not reprobates.” Paul is saying, we examined ourselves. “Now I pray to God that ye do no evil”: what Paul said then is the same for brothers and sisters today. “But that ye should do that which is honest, though we be as reprobates”: back then they were saying Paul was not right.

If you need help, reach out to us; we are here to help you. Do not allow Satan to destroy you, and do not allow your sins to weigh you down. Every last one of us has demons, thorns we are fighting, but what level of demon are you dealing with? Don’t walk around here acting like you are perfect and have everything together while during the week Satan has you in a chokehold.

“Nevertheless the foundation of God standeth sure, having this seal, The Lord knoweth them that are his.” God knows who belongs to him. “And, Let every one that nameth the name of Christ depart from iniquity.” Every last one of us that calls upon the name of the Lord must depart from iniquity. You brothers should not be adulterers, dealing with prostitutes and hoes. You sisters should not be sleeping around. Nobody should be running schemes, credit card fraud and all of that.

“But in a great house there are not only vessels of gold and of silver, but also of wood and of earth; and some to honour, and some to dishonour.” There are not just vessels of gold here in IUIC. There are some to honour and some that are dishonourable. The dishonourable one is faking it in here: he is not real, he is fake, here for his own reasons and ulterior motives.

So ask yourself: am I real or am I fake? Which vessel are you, and which vessel do you want to be? You alone know, because you know the things you do, what is in your mind and your thoughts. God will judge you. If you do not overcome these sexual sins and desires, you will be judged. We understand you are used to doing it on the regular and now you are going cold turkey and burning, but come and talk to the brothers, go talk to the sisters, and ask for help. Choose what vessel you are going to be: a vessel to honour or to dishonour.

sense.text:
“Go thy way, Daniel: for the words are closed up and sealed till the time of the end.” The world has changed, and America is not going back to how it used to be. The words are sealed up until the time of the end, and the time of the end began when Christ came on the earth and died.

That is why ever since Christ came, time changed and was counted around him: year one, year two, year three. Time is really a con. The year of our Lord is really the year of our destruction; that is Esau. It has been 2,026 years since Christ came on the earth.

“Many shall be purified, and made white, and tried.” Many brothers and sisters will be purified and made white. To be made white is to be made pure, to be made righteous; it is not talking about you being a white man. And you are going to be tried.

“But the wicked shall do wickedly: and none of the wicked shall understand.” The book is sealed until the end, and the end is the time we are living in right now. The wicked are going to steep in their sins and keep doing wickedly, and none of them will understand what is happening on the earth today. Why are Russia and Ukraine murdering each other? Why is America breaking the treaties it had with Europe, and why is NATO being dismantled? Why are so many racist white people, neo-Nazis, rising up all over the world saying we want all black people out of our country? Why is the US government murdering its citizens, and ICE agents terrorizing the streets of America? A lot of people came here thinking America was the land of opportunity, the lightbearer of peace, justice and rights for everyone, sold on Hollywood and the American dream, and now agents are hunting them down and snatching them up. An ICE agent shot a woman in her face. We all thought America was about peace and justice and love for all, until we got a rude awakening.

“But the wise shall understand.” We understand why these things are happening: why slavery happened, why Corona happened, why Trump went into Venezuela and took Maduro. The wicked are not going to understand.

And you Christians praying to white Jesus: pray to your God. Maybe white Jesus will make Donald Trump stop going to war, stop him from taking Greenland, put his spirit on Putin to stop killing the Ukrainians. How about that, you black stupid Christians? He didn’t hear you in slavery, because he went into a far country or he was sleeping. He didn’t hear you when the coronavirus was killing millions, when your pastors were praying for it to leave and it never left, and you had to close your churches down. Pray to him to bring peace on the earth; maybe he will hear you today.

precepts.why:
“Go and cry unto the gods which ye have chosen.” Our people chose to worship the image of the beast, the white image of Christ. That is the god you chose, so go cry to him. Go cry to him about Donald Trump.

“Let them deliver you in the time of your tribulation.” Let him deliver you from Trump. When tribulation comes on this earth, and bad things are about to happen on this earth, go to white Jesus and pray to him. During slavery he went on vacation and did not hear you; maybe he will hear you now, when you see things start to get bad.

This is what the God we worship said; this is the state of mind of our God. “I am come to send fire on the earth; and what will I, if it be already kindled?” The Lord came to send fire on the earth, and that fire is already kindled.

“Suppose ye that I am come to give peace on earth? I tell you, Nay; but rather division.” That is what Christians think: that Jesus Christ is about peace on the earth in this wicked kingdom. He said nay. Christ did not bring peace to this wicked kingdom. He came to bring division, war and destruction. That is what our God came to bring on the earth.

“Behold, saith the Lord, I will bring plagues upon the world; the sword, famine, death, and destruction.” Plagues are coming upon this world: war, diseases, famine, death and destruction. And who is bringing these things? Christ is the one sending these plagues on the earth.

You Christians running around with Jesus is love and everybody love, that is not realistic, and that is not what Christ came to bring. War, death and destruction are coming on this earth, and you can pray to white Jesus from now till whenever, but nothing is going to change. It is going to get worse and worse.

The world we live in is a changed world. It is the beginning of sorrows, and you are going to see some horrible things take place on this earth. Shame on those of you that go back into the world. This year America will be 250 years old, and the average empire lasts about 250 years before it declines. That is why Trump is so gung-ho about making it great: he knows it is declining. They are trying to fix the gay stuff and get the immigrants out, but it won’t work. The things America was built upon are rooted in its fabric, and as you try to unravel it, it will keep unravelling.

sense.text:
Hegemony is leadership or predominant influence exercised by one nation over others, aggression or expansion by large nations to achieve world domination. America’s hegemony is America’s rulership over the world, and the Bible shows how America became a superpower and gained dominion over the world.

“I will shew unto thee the judgment of the great whore that sitteth upon many waters.” The great whore is America. She’s a hoe. She sits upon many waters.

“With whom the kings of the earth have committed fornication, and the inhabitants of the earth have been made drunk with the wine of her fornication.” The nations of the earth are drunk with the wine of her fornication.

“I saw a woman sit upon a scarlet coloured beast”: this woman is America, sitting upon the red dragon of Revelation 13. America is the one that sits on top of that red dragon, “having seven heads and ten horns.”

“Arrayed in purple and scarlet colour, and decked with gold and precious stones and pearls”: this woman is rich. America is the richest country in the world. “Having a golden cup in her hand full of abominations and filthiness of her fornication.”

“And upon her forehead was a name written, MYSTERY.” Why a mystery? Because a lot of people, a lot of our people, don’t understand who America is. America is “BABYLON THE GREAT, THE MOTHER OF HARLOTS”, the mother of hoes, and the abomination of the earth.

“And the beast that was, and is not, even he is the eighth”: this is America. The beast had seven heads and ten horns; America became the eighth, the superpower that sits upon all of them. “And is of the seven”: the eighth came from the seven, from Britain. “And goeth into perdition”: perdition means destruction. America will be destroyed.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest are ten kings”: that is Europe, the European nations. The common market was originally ten; today it is over twenty. “Which have received no kingdom as yet”: at that time the European Union was not founded as yet. “But receive power as kings one hour with the beast”: they are going to rule the earth one hour with the beast, and the beast here is America. This began after 1945, after World War II.

“These have one mind”: Europe. The European Union has one mind; they all think collectively. All the white people in Europe came together after World War II and said, we will have one mind, share our economic and military strength and boost all our economies. There are no black nations in the European Union. It is all Caucasian, all white people. That is the ten horns.

“And shall give their power and strength unto the beast”: Europe gave its power and strength, its military and everything, unto America. This prophecy was written two thousand years ago, and it happened in 1945.

“These shall make war with the Lamb, and the Lamb shall overcome them.” Europe is going to make war with Christ, and Christ will destroy them. Don’t think Christ is going to return and white people are going to embrace him with warm arms. “For he is Lord of lords, and King of kings: and they that are with him are called, and chosen, and faithful”: that is the saints.

“The waters which thou sawest, where the whore sitteth, are peoples, and multitudes, and nations, and tongues.” All nations are here in America. That is why you have all nations here: to let you know America is that whore.

“And the ten horns which thou sawest upon the beast, these shall hate the whore.” According to the prophecy, Europe is going to hate America, and America is going to do a lot of things to cause Europe to hate her. That is the time we are living in right now. First they gave their power unto America; now something is happening where they will take away the power they gave. That goes into NATO, which they formed with America selling them all their weapons. All of that is going to change.

“And shall make her desolate and naked, and shall eat her flesh, and burn her with fire”: with thermonuclear destruction.

“For God hath put in their hearts to fulfil his will, and to agree, and give their kingdom unto the beast, until the words of God shall be fulfilled.” God put it in the European minds to give their kingdom unto America for a time. Before Europe burns America with fire, they had to give their power to America.

After 1945, America and the Europeans formed the alliance called NATO, the North Atlantic Treaty Organization, for collective security, where an attack on one member is an attack on all. That is Europe giving their power unto the beast: the Europeans stopped making weapons, and America supplied Europe and NATO. America became the superpower after World War II, after it dropped the bomb on Japan, and everything changed. They formed NATO, the IMF, the World Bank and the World Council of Churches, and set up a new order with America on top ruling and Europe under America. That is the woman sitting on the ten horns.

The UN was set up for white people, the European Union and America, to keep the dark nations in subjection and poor, to rob and steal from them. America does not follow UN rules and neither does Europe, but the dark nations are told they must follow them or be destroyed. The people that make the rules made them for the dark nations, not for themselves.

It has been over seventy years since World War II, and that time is up. God allowed Europe to come together with America for a time, and now it is changing. Germany says it is back on track and Europe will be strong again; Congress has a bill to take America out of NATO. Donald Trump is doing what the Lord wants him to do. He is fulfilling prophecy, and the NATO alliance between America and Europe is going to fall apart.

“And they shall scoff at the kings”: the king goes into president too. Look at what they did in Venezuela: they went over and took a sitting president. That is how the white man rolls with the presidents and leaders of other countries: we don’t respect you, your king is worthless. Trump was caught saying all of them kiss my ass. Damn: that is a true white man right there. That is how America is, and that is how Europe was.

“And the princes shall be a scorn unto them: they shall deride every strong hold.” They take every stronghold. “For they shall heap dust, and take it”: dust is confusion. They say Venezuela is a drug dealer bringing fentanyl to America, Maduro is a drug dealer, and everybody believes it. That is the confusion, the distraction, and then they go over and take him. That is how he rolls.

“Then shall his mind change.” America was always a violent group of people. They do what they want and take what they want. They took this land from the North American Indians and put them on reservations, overthrew a bunch of people in South America, and in the early 1900s went into Haiti, took the gold and murdered the leaders. That is the real America.

When did the white man’s mind change? After 1945, when America became the world’s economic and military superpower and the head of the beast. You cannot speak against Hitler’s killing and oppression and be the leader of the world and the head of Europe while you are still lynching and still segregated in America. So America changed its act for the world, to look like it was about justice, peace and rights. That is why they really gave you civil rights. It was not because they love you. To govern the world, nobody would take them seriously if they were still lynching us and showing their hate openly, so they started doing it secretly. Section 8, food stamps and all those things were to pacify you.

“And he shall pass over, and offend.” That is what he is doing today. A lot of you thought the white man changed, but he is changing back to who he used to be. Make America great again means going back to before the sixties, back to the Monroe Doctrine: American supremacy, white supremacy, America ruling the western hemisphere.

precepts.why:
“Never trust thine enemy.” The Lord says don’t ever trust your enemy. After the civil rights movement a lot of you trusted the white man; some of you even have kids by him and run around saying you love him. Some brothers married a white woman and have kids by her. God says never trust your enemy.

“For like as iron rusteth, so is his wickedness.” You can’t get rid of his wickedness. You think he changed; this man has not changed. You can shine a piece of iron and make it look good, but leave it there and over time it will rust. That is how the white man’s wickedness is: even though he says I changed, I don’t oppress you any more, I gave you civil rights, God says his wickedness will always appear. That is what you see all over America today, the KKK and the Nazi supremacists, ICE officers that are Nazis.

“Though he humble himself, and go crouching, yet take good heed and beware of him.” During the civil rights movement the white man humbled himself: we are going to help you, march with you, you have the right to use the same toilet we use. The liberals bow down and say they are sorry for what their forefathers did in slavery, while the other side says to hell with you, you are a better Christian because I kidnapped you and brought you over here. Either way, beware of him.

“And thou shalt be unto him as if thou hadst wiped a lookingglass”: you should see right through him, because he is your enemy. In the sixties our people knew who the enemy was, but today you have fallen asleep and forgotten. That is why it surprises a lot of you when Trump and these leaders do and say things against our people, and you cry that it is not part of the Constitution. The Constitution was written when you were a slave. When it said all men were created equal, it was not talking about you, because the same constitution called you three-fifths of a man. For only about sixty years have they given us a few rights, and now “his rust hath not been altogether wiped away”: he is changing back to his true nature.

“Set him not by thee, lest, when he hath overthrown thee, he stand up in thy place”: don’t set him by you, don’t make marriages with him and his woman. That happened in South Africa and in many South American countries: they bring white people in and they overthrow the country. Even in Venezuela there are a lot of CIA agents at work. “Neither let him sit at thy right hand, lest he seek to take thy seat, and thou at the last remember my words, and be pricked therewith.”

“Who will pity a charmer that is bitten with a serpent”: the serpent is your enemy, the white man. You want to befriend white people and bring them to your house, and when they bite you nobody is going to feel sorry for you, because we warned you. “So one that goeth to a sinner, and is defiled with him in his sins, who will pity?” Get caught up with the white man and the wickedness he pushes on this earth, and nobody will pity you.

The Monroe Doctrine of 1823 told the European powers not to colonize or interfere in the Americas and made the western hemisphere America’s sphere of influence: this side of the world belongs to America. That is their true nature. They conquered the North American Indians and took Puerto Rico. For the last seventy years that lapsed, and now Trump says we are the superpower, why are we playing games, and America is going back to the Monroe Doctrine, which Trump calls the Donroe Doctrine: no longer the police of the world, but making sure it controls every country in its hemisphere. That is the old colonizing, oppressive nature returning: the rust coming back on the iron.

sense.text: Does the Bible speak about the Monroe Doctrine? Yes, it does. “And when he had opened the fourth seal”: this is the fourth seal, the time we are living in right now. The fifth seal goes into the saints of God being killed; we have not met that time as yet, but it is approaching. The fourth seal is the beginning of sorrows: wars, rumours of wars, kingdoms, famine.

“And I looked, and behold a pale horse: and his name that sat on him was Death, and Hell followed with him.” This is talking about America.

“And power was given unto them over the fourth part of the earth.” Power was given unto America. A book on the birth of America calls it the fourth part of the world: America is referred to as the fourth part of the world, so when the Bible speaks of the fourth part of the earth it is talking about America. This is the Monroe Doctrine, revised as the Donroe Doctrine, and the Bible speaks of it.

“To kill with sword, and with hunger, and with death”: with war and with famine, and there is going to be a lot of death that America brings on this earth in this time on the fourth part of the earth. “And with the beasts of the earth”: that is zoonosis. Through gain of function research they take diseases from beasts like monkeys and bats, create viruses, and kill us.

precepts.why:
This explains Hell and Death. “Behold, his soul which is lifted up is not upright in him”: this is talking about America. “Because he transgresseth by wine”: wine is falsehood, lies. “He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home”: he is in every country.

“Who enlargeth his desire as hell”: his desire is the oil, the minerals, the resources, the rare earths. He enlarges his desire as hell. “And is as death”: when he comes through, he brings death. “And cannot be satisfied”: America is not satisfied. “But gathereth unto him all nations”: all nations are living here in America.

So Hell that follows the pale horse is America’s desire that is never satisfied, and Death is what America brings wherever it goes.

This shows what it means that power was given to kill with the sword and with death. “And ye shall hear of wars and rumours of wars”: a lot of those wars and rumours of wars are going to be started by America. “See that ye be not troubled: for all these things must come to pass, but the end is not yet.”

“For nation shall rise against nation, and kingdom against kingdom”: this is what will be happening during the fourth seal, the time we are living in. The kingdoms are the superpowers, Russia, Europe and America, and they will fight each other. Russia and NATO will fight each other; these things have to happen.

“And there shall be famines, and pestilences, and earthquakes, in divers places”: famine and diseases, the same thing read in Revelation 6. Everything read in Revelation 6 is what is read here, and the next thing is that they deliver us up to be killed, which is the fifth seal. The wars, rumours of wars and famine will take place because of that pale horse, which is America.

sense.text:
“For thou hast said in thine heart, I will ascend into heaven, I will exalt my throne above the stars of God”: that is them going into space, and America was the first.

“I will sit also upon the mount of the congregation, in the sides of the north”: that is the Monroe Doctrine. The congregation is Mexico, Central and South America, Panama, Puerto Rico, the Dominican Republic, Jamaica, Trinidad and the Caribbean islands, all the countries over here where the twelve tribes of Israel are. According to Bible prophecy, the king of Babylon, America the oppressor, will sit upon the congregation over here, the twelve tribes of Israel, and rule over us. They are in the American hemisphere, and America says it will rule over all of them: fall in line, or what was done to Maduro will be done to you.

The sides of the north is North America. That is why NATO is the North Atlantic Treaty: the treaty North America made with Europe. Bad things are about to happen to all our people on this side of the world, the Caribbean, South America, Panama, Guatemala. Remember what they did to Panama.
“I will ascend above the heights of the clouds”: who created airplanes? The Wright brothers, Americans. America invented the airplane. “I will be like the most High.”

precepts.why:
“It shall no more be said, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel out of the land of Egypt; But, The Lord liveth, that brought up the children of Israel from the land of the north.” The land of the north is North America, over on this side of the world. It is going to be said that the Lord brought the children of Israel out of the land of the north, “and from all the lands whither he had driven them: and I will bring them again into their land that I gave unto their fathers.”

This shows that Israel is in North America. So the congregation that America sits upon in the sides of the north is Israel: according to prophecy, America will be sitting on the congregations on this side of the world in the last days, during the fourth seal.

sense.text: “To the intent that the living may know that the most High ruleth in the kingdom of men, and giveth it to whomsoever he will.” The Most High rules in the kingdom of men. Even in these last days, God gave the rule. America is the superpower, and the president is Trump: God put Trump in that position.

precepts.why:
“The king’s heart is in the hand of the Lord, as the rivers of water: he turneth it whithersoever he will.” Whatever the Lord wants Trump to do, he is going to do it. Everything you see Trump doing today, God is allowing.

So you might ask why God is allowing Trump to snatch people up off the street and send them to prisons in other countries.
“Arise, O Lord, disappoint him, cast him down: deliver my soul from the wicked, which is thy sword.” This is why God allows it: the wicked is God’s sword. The so-called white man is God’s sword.

“Let us go again to our own people, and to the land of our nativity, from the oppressing sword.” An oppressing sword is being raised up all over the earth, especially in the western hemisphere and especially amongst our people. Who is the oppressing sword? The wicked.

Everything you see taking place with ICE, America going into Venezuela and snatching Maduro, the Donroe Doctrine, Trump telling the leader in Colombia to watch himself because he is coming for him next: that is the oppressing sword. Evil is about to take place on this earth. We are living in the beginning of sorrows, and it is going to get worse than the worst things you can think of. You thought World War II was bad; wait till you see what is about to happen. Don’t sit back comfortable because nothing has happened to you as yet.
“Take the wine cup of this fury at my hand, and cause all the nations, to whom I send thee, to drink it.” The Lord causes all the nations to drink of that cup.

“Babylon hath been a golden cup in the Lord’s hand, that made all the earth drunken.” Babylon is not only ancient Babylon; it is talking about America. The same cup the Lord told Jeremiah to make the nations drink is in Babylon’s hand. The Lord is using America, Trump and his administration, as his sword to bring judgment on the earth. Trump may be out of office and the next one take over, but God is using that administration. That golden cup is oppression, falsehood and lies.

“The nations have drunken of her wine; therefore the nations are mad.” That is what you see all over the world right now: the nations becoming angry with America, because what is in that cup is not only riches but America’s wrath and ill dealing, like going into Venezuela. Venezuela just sent millions of barrels of oil to America because the new leader is bowing down to Trump, afraid that what happened to Maduro will happen to her.

sense.text: “That the way of the kings of the east might be prepared”: prepared for war.

“Three unclean spirits like frogs come out of the mouth of the dragon, and out of the mouth of the beast, and out of the mouth of the false prophet.” The dragon is the white man. The three are their politics, their religion and their economics: unclean things going out of the mouth of Edom.

“For they are the spirits of devils, working miracles, which go forth unto the kings of the earth and of the whole world, to gather them.” Why are these things gathering them? Because these things are oppression: America destroying people’s economic systems, making war on nations and destroying them, supporting the Israelis in the land over there, dropping bombs on Iran, going into Venezuela and kidnapping a sitting president and calling him a drug dealer, saying it will take Greenland whether they like it or not. These are the policies America set up, the unclean things, and they are getting everybody around the world mad.

Iran’s money collapsed and the people are rising up against the government, and it has the Mossad and the CIA written all over it. That is what the IMF does: collapse your money so the people suffer and rise up. And when America’s war secretary boasts that America can project its will anywhere, any time, and that Maduro had his chance just like Iran had theirs, that is the white man showing his true self. That is the rust appearing on the iron again; that is why the Bible says never trust your enemy.

precepts.why:
This shows why Europe and everybody is going to turn against America. “He is a proud man, neither keepeth at home, who enlargeth his desire as hell”: the things he wants, he enlarges as hell. Trump just said Venezuela gave America four billion dollars’ worth of oil; they forced the Venezuelan government, and that is tribute money.

“And is as death, and cannot be satisfied”: nothing can satisfy America. Now he wants Greenland. He wants control over the whole western hemisphere; the oil is mine, rename the Gulf of Mexico the Gulf of America, it’s all mine. This man is turning back into his true nature. “But gathereth unto him all nations, and heapeth unto him all people.”

“Shall not all these take up a parable against him, and a taunting proverb against him, and say, Woe to him that increaseth that which is not his!” What is going to bring America’s fall is increasing in things that do not belong to him, like Venezuela and Greenland. These are the beginning of what is going to cause many conflicts and wars on the earth.

“Thus saith the Lord God concerning Edom; We have heard a rumour from the Lord, and an ambassador is sent among the heathen, Arise ye, and let us rise up against her in battle.” Edom here is mainly America and Israel. Somebody is going to say, let us rise up against them in battle.

“Behold, I have made thee small among the heathen: thou art greatly despised.” America will do things to be despised; the nations will hate America and Israel for what they are doing on the earth. “The pride of thine heart hath deceived thee”, “whose habitation is high; that saith in his heart, Who shall bring me down to the ground?” “Though thou exalt thyself as the eagle”: the eagle lets us know it is talking about America. “And though thou set thy nest among the stars”: that is space travel. “Thence will I bring thee down, saith the Lord.”

“If thieves came to thee, if robbers by night, (how art thou cut off!) would they not have stolen till they had enough?” This tells why America is going to be cut off, why Europe is going to turn against America: because they are thieves. America just stole four billion dollars’ worth of oil from Venezuela, and it is going to do that all over this side of the world. “How are the things of Esau searched out!” What causes the nations to turn against America is affliction, oppression, stealing and taking things that do not belong to him.

Denmark, which is over Greenland, is part of NATO. If Trump invades Greenland, Europe cannot fight America, and the NATO alliance with America will be dissolved. And no Democrat is coming to fix things and rock us back to sleep. The will of God has to be fulfilled. We are living in the beginning of sorrows, and things are going to get worse and worse.

sense.text:
This shows what America is called, and the oppression our people are going through. “In the day that the Lord shall give thee rest from thy sorrow, and from thy fear, and from the hard bondage wherein thou wast made to serve, That thou shalt take up this proverb against the king of Babylon”: the king of Babylon is America. This is the cup all nations are going to be drinking of.

“How hath the oppressor ceased!” Oppression is coming to this place, and the oppressor is America. “The golden city ceased!” The golden city, the richest on this earth, is America. How is it ceased, how is it destroyed?
“The Lord hath broken the staff of the wicked, and the sceptre of the rulers”: the Lord has destroyed them.

“He who smote the people in wrath with a continual stroke”: America is going to smite the people in wrath. We have not met this point as yet, but it is coming. That oppression is rising up on our people, and it will be continual. It is not going to stop; don’t think things are going to get better. “He that ruled the nations in anger”: America will rule the nations in anger, as he just did to Venezuela.

“How art thou fallen from heaven, O Lucifer, son of the morning!” America is also called Lucifer because America acted like a Christian nation about justice and rights on the earth, but they were never about that. “Which didst weaken the nations”: they weaken the nations through their economics. They have the IMF and the World Bank and control the world’s money. Iran’s money has collapsed and the people are rioting, and they collapsed the Venezuelan money too. Going into Venezuela is not only about the oil; it is about weakening Russia and China. When Trump makes that move, Russia and China are weakened.

“Is this the man”: Lucifer is a man, the white man. “That made the earth to tremble”: everybody is afraid of America. The sitting president in Venezuela is scared; she just gave them four billion dollars’ worth of oil, while the people of Venezuela suffer and Trump rounds up Venezuelans all over the United States and deports them. It is not about the people. “That did shake kingdoms”: with the bombs they drop on them.

“That made the world as a wilderness, and destroyed the cities thereof”: this is not fulfilled yet. It was fulfilled in the land of Palestine, which became a wilderness under the US bombs, but America is going to make the world as a wilderness and destroy many cities on this earth. Things are about to get bad on this earth.

“That opened not the house of his prisoners”: they never let you go. You think you are free, but God says they never let you go. You are not free. Prepare yourself for what is coming.
